actions.action: Track completion separately for each requested item
actions.mechanism: Calculate outstanding quantities from linked physical receipts, keeping supplier promises separate from delivered quantities.
actions.implementation: Add request-line IDs, requested quantities, cumulative accepted receipts, outstanding quantities, and item status to the existing spreadsheet. Link multiple deliveries per line.
actions.check: For ten requested units, record receipts of four and three: show seven received, three outstanding. Confirmation alone changes neither.
actions.risk: Unapproved substitute items must not count toward completion.

actions.action: Assign an independent owner to every substitution
actions.mechanism: Separate substitution decisions from receipt entry, preserving the original request and the decision rationale.
actions.implementation: Record proposed item, quantity equivalence, named non-requester approver, decision, rationale, and timestamp. Block requester approval; hold substitute receipts pending decision.
actions.check: Attempt self-approval and verify rejection. Approve through another teammate; verify rationale remains visible and only approved quantities reduce outstanding amounts.
actions.risk: Unavailable approvers can delay completion; designate another eligible teammate.

actions.action: Validate receipts before updating delivered totals
actions.mechanism: Duplicate detection prevents double counting; excess quantities remain visible exceptions rather than silently closing requests.
actions.implementation: Stage receipt entries using supplier, receipt number, and line ID. Flag repeated keys and cumulative excess; record excess disposition without changing requested quantities.
actions.check: Submit the same receipt twice: totals change once. Receive twelve against ten requested: show two excess and an unresolved exception.
actions.risk: Different receipt numbers can conceal duplicates; compare item, quantity, and date.

actions.action: Review an exception queue each working day
actions.mechanism: Named next actions distinguish incomplete deliveries, pending decisions, and excess stock from requests needing no intervention.
actions.implementation: Filter existing records for outstanding quantities, pending substitutions, and unresolved receipt exceptions. Assign each a teammate, next action, and review date; retain closure reasons.
actions.check: Seed a partial delivery, pending substitution, and excess receipt. Verify each appears with an owner and stays open until explicitly resolved.
actions.risk: Stale receipt entry makes the queue misleading; check unentered receipts first.
